technique_cue_conflicts_resolved.conflict: EDS:mapping alone would be incompatible: the micrograph cue class allows SEM/TEM/STEM/HAADF/OPTICAL/AFM/EBSD/CLSM/FLUORESCENCE families, not EDS
technique_cue_conflicts_resolved.resolution: panel is a STEM-EDS element map, so technique is the list ["TEM:STEM", "EDS:mapping"]; the TEM family satisfies the micrograph cue and the panel citation stands

technique_cue_conflicts_resolved.conflict: "immunofluorescence staining" normalises to ASSAY:stain, which is not in the micrograph cue list
technique_cue_conflicts_resolved.resolution: the instrument that produced the panel is a fluorescence microscope, so technique is OPTICAL:fluorescence (OPTICAL is in the micrograph list); the stain is the subject and stays in the label

technique_cue_conflicts_resolved.note: no other conflict. F1e (TEM:HAADF) and F2c (TEM) satisfy their micrograph cue directly. Every other cited crop has cue classes [] and is not checked. F4 and F5 are tier C with no panels offered, so they are cited as whole figures with panel_ids [] and carry no cue check.

merged_nodes: F1c (TEM), F1d (SEM) and F1e (HAADF-STEM) merged into one appearance node o1: all three state the same claim, that the vesicles are hollow spheres built from one densely packed particle layer; technique carried as a three-instrument list
F1l (H2O2 decomposition) and F1m (O2 generation) merged into one node o7: both read the same claim, that catalytic turnover happens only for dissociated MVs
F4G (CD8+ fraction), F4H (CD8/Treg ratio), F4I (TNF-a) and F4J (IFN-g) merged into one node o16: one claim, that every systemic immune readout ranks Dox-MVs plus aPD-L1 first
F5D (effector-memory T cells), F5E and F5F (serum cytokines after rechallenge) merged into one node o17: one claim, reactivated memory immunity is strongest in the same group
F5B (secondary tumour volume) and F5H (lung nodule counts) merged into one node o18: one claim, secondary tumour burden is suppressed
"bare MVs are non-cytotoxic up to 400 ug/mL" folded into attrs.image_note of o9 rather than kept as a separate biosafety node; F4F body-weight curves dropped for the same reason
F1j (DLS distributions after hypoxic incubation) not given its own node: it restates o4's dissociation claim in a second panel kind and would have had to be split from it
notes: 18 of 25 offered panels cited. Not cited: F1a, F1b (schematics, read from the whole figure and used only for the PRC labels, which carry figs F1 with panel_ids []), F1g, F1j, F2b, F3c, F3d.
